initial_findings.resolution: Fixture-only corrections: consumed bait repeat is not a fresh pickup, moving slab probes stay below lintels, overlapping prerequisite gate is prepared open, and each contact setup stands above its actual supported floor. Deficits restored between independent ammo probes to prevent cascading false findings; runtime/scenes unchanged.

limitations: Declared remote setup placements followed by short actual W approaches; this is not a continuous physical campaign route.
All AI physics frozen to isolate interactions. Arena deaths are injected lethal damage with negative synthetic shot IDs and no accepted player shots; this is not combat balance or survival proof.
Entry snapshots deliberately contain every gun and over-capacity ammunition; actual Main restore clamps them before recording the retry snapshot.
Prerequisite progression gates are opened through their actual activate API with declared fixture permissions to isolate trap slabs; world progression flags/manual controls are not fabricated.
Door projectile probes inject existing native enemy projectiles and advance one swept motion explicitly; they do not claim live enemy attack cadence, player ordnance, render-rate or human acceptance.
Ordinary partial-box probes directly create a declared five-round-or-less deficit to verify actual acceptance and feedback; ammunition is restored to capacity between independent probes.
